acceptance: All three modes support edited multicam overlay video, separate audio, many cuts and already-derived scenes without flattening or changing the source.
Empty selection references all active timeline media; explicit selection is a hard temporal union. No unselected words, model context, decoder windows or output handles may cross its bounds.
Preserve original multicam cuts, enabled angles, source trims, retiming, sync and mix in additional scenes. Validate versioned scope archives, undo and reload through canonical app.state.read.
Use existing scoped transcription coverage or resume matching work; missing transcripts decode/transcribe only selected time, skip excluded sections and cannot impersonate a full-episode transcript.
Regression tests and real edited-project isolated checks verify both reference modes, all three creation paths, original scene/caption preservation and deployed UI availability.
